'''Ajimbura''' is [[Furyk Karede]]'s manservant and ''[[so'jhin]]''.

== Appearance ==
He is wiry and has blue eyes, with dark red hair. He has cut off his white-streaked braid in devotion to Karede, a notion that usually proclaims him as a self-professed coward to his tribe.

== History ==
He is originally from a hill-tribe in the [[Kaensada|Kaensada Hills]] in Seanchan before joining the [[Ever Victorious Army]] as a ''so'jhin''.

== Activities ==
He travels with Karede, when they are looking for the kidnapped [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]]. He kills a standard-bearer for insulting Karede. He manages to locate the camp where Tuon is held and goes with Karede to meet with the leader of it. When Tuon's presence is confirmed, he slips away to inform [[Musenge]].
